tools.name: Trae
tools.description: Trae AI is an innovative AI-powered Integrated Development Environment (IDE) designed to transform and streamline the coding process. By leveraging advanced AI capabilities, Trae AI offers adaptive collaboration, smart autocomplete, and real-time code generation features. This tool is tailored to enhance developer productivity by automating tasks, providing intelligent code suggestions, and facilitating better team communication. With support for multiple programming languages and seamless integration with popular development environments, Trae AI is a comprehensive solution for developers of all levels, aiming to boost efficiency and reduce project completion times.
bullets: Efficiency Boost: Significantly enhances coding speed and productivity.

tools.name: Theia IDE
tools.description: Theia IDE is a modern, extensible integrated development environment available both in the cloud and on the desktop. Built on the open-source Theia Platform, it offers VS Code compatibility, rich language support, and a fully transparent, AI-powered development experience.
bullets: Flexible deployment—cloud or desktop—on a single codebase.
Pluggable architecture with strong VS Code compatibility.

tools.name: runway
tools.description: Runway ML is an advanced AI-powered creative toolkit designed for artists, designers, and content creators to generate and edit visuals, videos, and 3D assets with ease. It leverages cutting-edge machine learning models for real-time video editing, image synthesis, and generative AI applications, making high-end creative tools accessible without requiring deep technical knowledge.
bullets: AI-Powered Editing Tools: Advanced video and image editing features make complex tasks easy.
Text-to-Video & AI Generation: Enables content creation without manual animation or design skills.

tools.name: RegexMy
tools.description: RegexMy is a versatile platform offering powerful AI tools designed to streamline search and file operations tasks. It features an AI-powered regex builder, XPath builder, and tools for file summarization, reporting, translation, and code localization. Whether you're looking to enhance productivity or ensure accuracy in your workflow, RegexMy provides advanced features to meet your needs.
bullets: Efficiency: AI tools significantly reduce the time spent on regex and XPath tasks.
Versatility: Offers a range of features from file summarization to localization.

tools.name: OpenAI - GPT 4.1
tools.description:
GPT-4.1 is OpenAI’s newest multimodal large language model, designed to deliver highly capable, efficient, and intelligent performance across a broad range of tasks. It builds on the foundation of GPT-4 and GPT-4 Turbo, offering enhanced reasoning, greater factual accuracy, and smoother integration with tools like code interpreters, retrieval systems, and image understanding.
With native support for a 128K token context window, function calling, and robust tool usage, GPT-4.1 brings AI closer to behaving like a reliable, adaptive assistant—ready to work, build, and collaborate across tasks with speed and precision.
bullets: Massive Context Memory: 128K tokens open up longer workflows

tools.name: UI Pilot
tools.description: uiPilot is an AI-driven tool that converts natural-language design descriptions into pixel-perfect UI components instantly. It helps developers and designers create modern front-end elements—like badges, hero sections, and navbars—quickly and efficiently.
bullets: Accelerates front-end development through AI-generated UI components.
Combines creativity and code with a simple natural-language interface.

tools.name: Latta
tools.description: Latta AI is an AI-powered debugging tool designed to help software developers, testers, project managers, and users efficiently find and fix non-working code and bugs. It aims to streamline the debugging process by automating bug detection and resolution, ultimately enhancing productivity and accelerating release cycles for individuals and teams.
bullets: Automated AI-Powered Bug Fixing: Significantly reduces manual debugging effort and time.
Seamless Integration with Developer Workflows: Works directly within IDEs and connects with GitHub/GitLab.

tools.name: DeepCode (Snyk Code)
tools.description: Snyk Code is an AI-powered static application security testing (SAST) and auto-fixing tool built for developers. It scans source code in real time to uncover vulnerabilities and security issues, offering instant, actionable fix recommendations within your IDE and during pull requests. Designed to integrate seamlessly into developer workflows, Snyk Code combines speed, accuracy, and context-awareness to enhance code security.
bullets: Real-Time Detection & Fixes: Catch and resolve issues early in development.
Actionable Remediation: Offers one-click fixes backed by expert-validated recommendations.

tools.name: LM-Kit
tools.description: LM-Kit is a comprehensive toolkit designed to integrate generative AI capabilities into .NET applications. It provides developers with a seamless way to enhance their applications with advanced AI features, enabling them to build smarter and more efficient software solutions. With LM-Kit, developers can unlock the full potential of generative AI without the need for extensive setup or complex integrations.
bullets: Seamless Integration: Easy to integrate with .NET applications

tools.name: Greptile
tools.description: Greptile is an AI-powered search engine tailored for software developers—it understands code context, comments, and natural language. By indexing your private or public repositories, Greptile provides semantically-informed code search, examples, and auto-completion across large codebases—making code exploration faster and smarter.
bullets: Makes code discovery fast and precise across large code collections.
Combines natural language search with code-aware AI completions.

tools.name: Windsurf
tools.description: Windsurf.ai is a powerful AI-driven code assistant designed to help developers write, navigate, and understand code faster and more efficiently. By integrating advanced AI with your codebase, Windsurf provides intelligent code search, in-context code explanations, and AI-powered code completion to boost developer productivity and accelerate software development workflows.
bullets: Natural Language Search: Makes exploring large codebases simple and intuitive.
AI-Powered Code Understanding: Helps both new and experienced developers grasp complex code.

tools.name: Amazon CodeGuru
tools.description: Amazon CodeGuru is a machine learning-powered developer tool from AWS that helps you automate code reviews and optimize application performance. By integrating seamlessly into your development workflow, CodeGuru analyzes your codebase for potential issues, security vulnerabilities, and performance bottlenecks—providing intelligent suggestions to improve code quality and reduce technical debt.
bullets: Automated Code Reviews: Saves time by catching common bugs

tools.name: Polycoder
tools.description: PolyCoder is an open-source AI code generation model focused on C programming, developed by researchers at Carnegie Mellon University. It is a GPT-2-based model trained on a curated dataset of open-source C code, offering a high-performing, transparent alternative to proprietary code generation tools. PolyCoder is designed to generate syntactically correct and contextually relevant C code, supporting research, educational use, and more privacy-conscious development environments.
bullets: Focused on C: Tailored training allows better performance for C than many general models.
Open and Free: Available under MIT license with full access to code and data.

tools.name: Swimm
tools.description: Swimm is an AI-powered code knowledge platform that supercharges documentation and accelerates mainframe modernization. It automatically reverse-engineers complex codebases—like COBOL and legacy systems—to build a living inventory of business logic, modules, dependencies, and architectural maps, all with accurate explanations and zero hallucinations.

tools.name: ReSharper
tools.description: ReSharper is a powerful Visual Studio extension developed by JetBrains that enhances .NET development with advanced code analysis, refactoring tools, and productivity boosters. It streamlines C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, and other .NET language development by offering intelligent suggestions, quick fixes, and deep code navigation features—all designed to help developers write cleaner, faster, and more maintainable code.
bullets: Excellent Refactoring Tools: Apply complex refactors in seconds without risk.
Intelligent Code Suggestions: Provides real-time inspections and context-specific recommendations.

tools.name: Replit
tools.description: Replit is an all-in-one, browser-based development platform that allows users to write, run, debug, and host code entirely online. It supports instant project creation, real-time collaboration, and deployment without any local setup, making it ideal for learners, teams, and creators looking to build software and applications quickly.
bullets: Instant Setup: Get coding right away in any supported language with no local dependencies.
Collaborative Editing: Ideal for pair programming

tools.name: CodeSandbox AI
tools.description: CodeSandbox is a powerful cloud-based development platform that enables developers to build, share, and collaborate on web applications entirely in the browser. With instant dev environments, GitHub integration, and real-time collaboration, CodeSandbox streamlines the entire software development workflow—from idea to deployment—without needing to install anything locally.
bullets: Zero Setup Development: Code starts running instantly with no local configuration.
Live GitHub Integration: Open PRs and branches as live

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.description: GitHub Copilot is an AI-powered code completion tool developed by GitHub and powered by OpenAI. It helps developers write code faster and more efficiently by suggesting full lines, functions, or entire blocks of code directly within the editor. Integrated with popular IDEs like Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, and Neovim, Copilot acts as a virtual pair programmer that understands your context and writes code in real-time.
bullets: Time-Saving Autocompletion: Suggests full lines and functions as you type.
IDE Integration: Works smoothly within popular code editors.

tools.name: CodeStory
tools.description: CodeStory is an AI-native, privacy-focused IDE (a fork of VS Code) that lets humans and AI pair-program together. It supports multi-file editing, proactive error fixing, intelligent code completion, and deep context awareness—all running locally with advanced AI agents to streamline complex development tasks.
